newsitem.title: USA: US West Coast prods ease amid lack of buyers.
newsitem.headline: US West Coast prods ease amid lack of buyers.

text.p: Wholesale prices for U.S. West Coast refined products were notionally lower Monday, driven by an onslaught of offers and no takers, brokers said.
A hydrocracker at Tosco's Los Angeles refinery was undergoing repairs that could bring it online next week, an industry source said.
A fire shut the 25,000 barrel-per-day unit last Thursday but failed to lift prices, traders said.
Fundamentals curbed fears of supply shortages, as stocks of gasoline rose 98,000 barrels in the latest supply survey, while the region's other refineries ran without incident.
CARB gasoline in Los Angeles fell one cent to 71/73 cents a gallon Monday, while San Francisco grade eased the same amount.
Distillates also fell about a cent, as slight gains on the energy futures market failed to inspire a rally.
